links.outcome: GPT accuracy on local retrospective HCC patient data vs expert consensus and tumor board decisions
links.effect: Liver function accuracy >85% across versions; BCLC staging 46.2% (GPT-4) to 84.0% (o3); treatment recommendation overall accuracy up to 90.6%.
links.quote: BCLC staging accuracy ranged from 46.2% (version 4) to 84.0% (o3), with misclassification of radiological reports as the main error source.

links.outcome: GPT recommendations compared against tumor board decisions and expert consensus, plus time and cost versus staff
links.effect: In 9-14% of cases GPT suggestions were retrospectively more guideline-concordant than tumor board decisions; GPT reduced costs approximately 300- to 1300-fold versus clinical staff.
links.quote: In 9-14% of cases, GPT suggestions were retrospectively more guideline-concordant than tumor board decisions.

unlisted_practices: Comparing short versus long prompt instructions on LLM accuracy
Time and cost comparison of LLM versus clinical staff

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing different prompt design strategies (short vs long instructions) and reasoning-optimized LLM models on retrospective clinical data for HCC staging and recommendations.
